primary_model.name: random_and_4
primary_model.definition: For every activated S-box input X, sample R uniformly from 0..15 and set X'=X AND R.
primary_model.paper_role: Primary biased model for SIFA, SEFA and SHFA experiments.

control_models.random_and_2: Randomize two mask-bit positions; pass the other two positions through.
control_models.single_bit_flip: Flip one uniformly selected input bit.
control_models.stuck_at_bit: Force one uniformly selected input bit to zero or one.
control_models.random_nibble: Replace the input nibble by a uniform random 4-bit value.
